title: The Albatross
prompt: A man goes into a restaurant, orders albatross, eats one bite, and kills himself. Why?
solution: The man was on a ship that was wrecked on a desert island. When the food ran out, another passenger brought him what he said was albatross, but it was really part of the man's wife, who had died in the wreck. The man suspected something, so when they were finally rescued he ordered albatross, realized that what he had eaten before was his wife, and killed himself.
